messages:
andrew: heads-up — ran into a customer case where a reconnect + toolcall path ended up double-counting ~30 tokens (console vs ledger mismatch). minimal repro attached below.

maria: can you paste the relevant logs/snippet?

andrew: sure, simplified lines:
```
[resume] session=shard-3 fpr=abc123 offset=1024
[toolcall] id=tool-79 start_ts=167000 end_ts=167020 tokens=18 provisional_entry=px-91
[toolcall] id=tool-79 commit_ts=167030 tokens_committed=18 ledger_entry=lk-212
[resume] session=shard-3 fpr=def456 offset=1024  # after kv-evict
[toolcall] id=tool-79 start_ts=167200 tokens=12 provisional_entry=px-92
[toolcall] id=tool-79 commit_ts=167220 tokens_committed=12 ledger_entry=lk-213
# console shows total tokens = 30, but expected 18 (first provisional should have been pruned)
```

samir: quick read — looks like KV cache eviction flipped session fingerprint (fpr). The first provisional stayed in the provisional window, then fallback+resume created another provisional and both committed. ledger allowed both since keys differed.

jia: is this just a variant of the prefix-capture-on-retry problem? or something different?

andrew: related but different root cause: our sliding-window "ledger trim" that prunes provisional entries on graceful fallback runs before the second toolcall, but it only trims by route+session id, not by toolcall signature. so if fpr changed we don't consider them the same.

maria: short-term mitigation idea: when committing provisional entries, dedupe on (route, client_fingerprint, toolcall_name, maybe nonce) rather than relying purely on provisional id. that would close this case.

samir: caveat — adding that check adds an extra index lookup on the hot commit path. could increase p50 token latency. maybe limit dedupe checks to toolcalls and streams that have _toolcall=true flag.

andrew: alternative approach: attach an ephemeral resume-nonce to the stream handshake. server echoes nonce on resume; ledger associates provisional entries with nonce so resume + replay will dedupe. requires client change but cheaper server-side.

jia: whichever we pick we need telemetry changes: add a per-route "provisional_commit_count" and "provisional_dedupe_attempts" metric. dashboard should show provisional vs confirmed ratio; alert when provisional commits > 0.1% of confirmed on any route over 1h.

maria: agreed. also add a small console widget for "recent provisional commits" with sample request ids so SRE can inspect.

andrew: I'll draft a tiny RFC. proposed quickfix: server-side dedupe on (route, toolcall_id, tool_hash) limited to the toolcall commit path + feature flag. longer-term: nonce handshake.

samir: test plan: synthetic harness that forces kv-evict every N requests and does 1k reconnects; compare ledger sum vs console-billing. add a unit test that simulates the FD window and double-commit path.

maria: sounds good. can we also add a small telemetry spike alert during the canary so we can roll back fast?

andrew: yes — ops alert: if provisional_dedupe_attempts > 10 for canary group in 5m, rollback. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Deploy triggered: deploy/ledger-dedupe-hotfix -> canary on eng-runtime at 2026-03-20T14:05Z.

samir: will monitor. I'll also add a console trace hook for route /v1/chat.generate to log provisional ids on commit (sampling 1%).

andrew: thanks. I'll open the RFC + PR and attach the synthetic job.

maria: FYI I filed ops ticket #INF-3254 to track rollout/telemetry and added it to the canary checklist. :white_check_mark:

jia: nice. once we have data we can decide whether to keep server dedupe or push for resume-nonce.

andrew: ack — moving to action items.
